historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of final scheduled game of Week X-1

method.alternate_hr: Calculated from exact locked Stage 1 l10_observations; count values >= alternate threshold; denominator remains 10.
method.core: Select an available FanDuel alternate with American odds from -350 through -150 inclusive, closest numerically to -250; tie -> more negative odds.
method.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
method.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, whether or not its HR meets a threshold.
method.narrowing: Retain candidate if at least one selected Floor/Core/Ceiling threshold has L10 HR >=7/10, aligning with downstream minimum individual-leg historical HR; no current-week context used.

validation.discrepancy: Cole Kmet has FanDuel Receptions 1.5 and historical data in the raw source, but is absent from the exact locked Stage 1 State. Stage 2 did not add or re-screen him because Stage 1 is authoritative and no explicit Stage 1 rerun was requested.
